title: The Living Atlas
summary: Studio motion concepts for finding culture by place: a globe of light, an isometric Miami, drawn cities, a stamped passport and a discovery instrument.
description:
How Monumental maps the world: a glass globe of light ringed with stories, Miami picked out neighbourhood by neighbourhood in an isometric city, Deco line drawings of cities from Miami to London, a culture passport stamped stop by stop, and the Take Me Somewhere instrument printing a ticket for a thirty-minute trip.

Everything here is illustrative concept art from Monumental's studio, assembled as a demonstration of how the platform plays, saves and connects content. It is not programme footage; the maps are not to scale, and the routes, stamps and labels on screen are design placeholders.
